user.title: cn_im_hub Ultra
user.description: Choose one global conversation agent. Channels are added later from this integration page.

init.title: Set Global Agent
init.description: All channels use this single conversation agent.

send_message.name: Send Message
send_message.description: Send a message via the selected IM channel.

wechat_account_id.name: WeChat Account
wechat_account_id.description: Required when using WeChat with multiple bound accounts. Use the WeChat subentry title suffix or the full title, for example: WeChat (abc123@im.bot).

camera_entity.name: Camera Entity
camera_entity.description: Capture a snapshot from this camera and send it as an image. Supported by WeChat, WeCom, Feishu, and QQ channels.

tts_text.name: TTS Text
tts_text.description: Text to synthesize and send as voice when supported by the channel.

file_path.name: File Path
file_path.description: Absolute local file path to send as media.

file_url.name: File URL
file_url.description: Remote URL to download and send as media.

file_name.name: File Name
file_name.description: Optional outbound filename override for file media.

media_type.name: Media Type
media_type.description: Optional media type override for file_path or file_url.

message_format.name: Message Format
message_format.description: Optional outbound text format override. Currently QQ supports auto, text, and markdown.

approval_id.name: Approval ID
approval_id.description: When set, send the message as a QQ approval prompt with inline allow/deny buttons.

record_duration.name: Record Duration
record_duration.description: When camera_entity is used for video or GIF capture, planned recording or capture duration in seconds. GIF defaults to 3 seconds when omitted.

lookback.name: Lookback
lookback.description: Optional lookback seconds to include before camera video recording starts. Only applies to video capture.

gif_fps.name: GIF FPS
gif_fps.description: Frames per second when generating an animated GIF from camera snapshots.

card_json.name: Card JSON
card_json.description: JSON string of an interactive card to send (Feishu only).

card_content.name: Card Content
card_content.description: Card body text / markdown content (Feishu only).

card_buttons.name: Card Buttons
card_buttons.description: Buttons in simple format without JSON (Feishu only).

list_messages.name: List Messages
list_messages.description: List messages in the agent_mail mailbox (folder + pagination). Returns messages array.

read_message.name: Read Message
read_message.description: Read a full message (body, recipients, attachments).

search_messages.name: Search Messages
search_messages.description: Search messages by keyword. Returns messages array.

reply_message.name: Reply Message
reply_message.description: Reply to a message (two-phase confirmation handled automatically).

forward_message.name: Forward Message
forward_message.description: Forward a message to other recipients (two-phase confirmation handled automatically).

delete_message.name: Delete Message
delete_message.description: Delete a message. Soft delete by default (trash 30 days); permanent=true removes forever.
